N1.s: Iskoristili ste svih %lld besplatnih cutlinga. Nastavite u Cutlingu, otključajte ga i ovaj će se spremiti.
N1.back: Used-up you-have all 5 free cutlings. Continue in Cutling, unlock it and this-one will itself save.
N1.why: Opens with S3's own sentence so the same fact keeps the same words; 'Nastavite u Cutlingu' matches the continue choice the system offers, and 'ovaj' (masculine, after cutlinga) points at the item being saved; 103 characters.

N2.s: Iskoristili ste svih %lld besplatnih cutlinga. Za više otvorite i otključajte Cutling.
N2.back: Used-up you-have all 5 free cutlings. For more open and unlock Cutling.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1; 'Za više' is the everyday Croatian 'for more', and two verbs sharing one object ('otvorite i otključajte Cutling') says where to go without a second clause; 83 characters.

N3.why: 'Spremljeno' is the neuter toast Croatian iOS shows after a save; 'slobodno' (vacant) with 'mjesto' left out, as in K1's 'zauzeto', says one place is left, where 'besplatno' would run to 31; exactly 30 characters.

N4.why: 'Zauzeto' is K1's word for the places being taken, so the keyboard says one thing from the fifth save to the sixth; 'X od Y' is the number pair from S5 and M4, used count first, so no positional forms; 26 characters.

N5.why: Picks up N4's 'Zauzeto' and K1's vi imperative 'Otključajte'; 'i spremite' tells the person this item will still go in once they unlock, with the object understood because they are mid-save; 38 characters.

N6.why: Buttons take the ti imperative, as S15 and the vocabulary's 'Nastavi' do; 9 characters in the save button's place.

N7.s: Iskoristili ste svih %lld besplatnih cutlinga. Otključajte Cutling i ovaj će se spremiti.
N7.back: Used-up you-have all 5 free cutlings. Unlock Cutling and this-one will itself save.
N7.why: The same two halves as N1 without the continue step, since the form sits inside the Share sheet; 'ovaj' points at the item the form shows; 86 characters over two lines.

N8.s: Ovaj cutling vas čeka. Spremit će se kad otvorite i otključate Cutling.
N8.back: This cutling you awaits. Save-will itself when you-open and unlock Cutling.
N8.why: 'Vas čeka' says it is kept for the person in their own terms, and steers clear of 'sačuvan', which a Croatian reader could take for 'saved'; the second sentence reuses N2's 'otvorite i otključajte Cutling'; 71 characters.
